claims.claim: AIIB signed a record $1.6 billion climate policy-based financing package with Türkiye at COP31 on Nov 12, 2026, plus $300 million via Turk Eximbank.
AIIB and GGGI agreed on Nov 14, 2026 at COP31 in Antalya to deepen cooperation on climate-resilient infrastructure project preparation, investment-ready pipelines, and technical assistance.
AIIB hosts dedicated COP31 Antalya programming on November 16, 2026 connecting climate finance, project preparation, and smart green resilient infrastructure.
